password.description: The password required to access the proxy. Must be changed from default for security.

port.description: The port number on which the proxy listens.

connection_timeout.description: Connection timeout in minutes. 0 means no timeout.

bind_address.description: Local address to bind the proxy service to.

external_bind_address.description: External address used for Internet communication.

public_address.description: Public IP address displayed on the Proxy Status Page.

registration_name.description: Unique identifier (e.g., callsign) for registering with the EchoLink website.

callsigns_denied.description: Regular expression pattern for callsigns to deny access.

callsigns_allowed.description: Regular expression pattern for callsigns to allow access.

additional_external_bind_addresses.description: Comma-separated list of additional addresses for external interfaces.
